summary.content:
• Systems-focused Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building scalable backend systems, infrastructure tooling and OS-level integrations.

  • Specialized in Go, TypeScript, and Rust, with experience spanning IoT platforms (billions of events/month), decentralized systems (DePIN), and Linux authentication (PAM).

  • Creator of Biopass, an open-source biometric authentication system for Linux, integrating face and fingerprint recognition with a lightweight runtime and IR-based anti-spoofing.

items.description:
• Reduced manual VM provisioning effort by automating discovery and configuration using Zabbix + cloud-init

  • Developed an internal desktop security scanning application, improving vulnerability detection and standardizing security checks across systems.

  • Built and maintained system hardening and baseline compliance scripts for legacy and modern environments, including Windows XP, Windows Server, Ubuntu, and Fedora.

  • Automated security configuration enforcement and rollback (harden/unharden) processes to support testing, auditing, and incident response workflows.

  • Contributed to system design, feature proposals, and security improvements, collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance platform reliability and compliance posture.

items.name: Biopass
items.description:
Core Maintainer of Biopass (Linux Biometric Authentication System) with 150+ stars. It is used by real users and actively maintained as an alternative to existing Linux authentication solutions (e.g., Howdy).

  • Architected a pluggable authentication system integrating with Linux PAM stack

  • Built biometric authentication workflows (face + fingerprint) with unified UX similar to Windows Hello

  • Implemented IR-based anti-spoofing pipeline with on-device AI inference

  • Designed lightweight runtime (~13MB) with minimal dependencies, significantly smaller than alternatives (e.g., Howdy's size is from 1GB to 2GB, including dependencies)

  • Worked at OS level: login managers, PAM modules, credential propagation

  • Packaged and distributed across APT, RPM, and AUR ecosystems

  • Led project direction, code reviews, and community contributions

items.name: Tonic
items.description:
Developed Tonic, a code-first OpenAPI documentation generator for Go frameworks (49★)

  • Built a reflection-based system to derive API schemas directly from structs and route definitions

  • Eliminated reliance on comment-based tools (e.g., Swaggo), preventing documentation drift

  • Generated OpenAPI 3.0 specs and Swagger UI dynamically at runtime

  • Designed modular, framework-agnostic architecture with adapter support (e.g., Echo)

DEPIN Platform Development:

  • Designed and implemented a decentralized physical infrastructure (DePIN) platform using NestJS and PostgreSQL for the backend, which can manage 5000+ online edge computers.

  • Built a Golang CLI using K8s APIs to manage node operations, task execution, and platform workflows on users' K3s clusters.

  • Integrated crypto payment systems and task delegation mechanisms

  • Worked independently and communicated directly with customers to clarify requirements, provide updates, and deliver features.

Game Launcher Platform Development:

  • Developed a JavaScript SDK to help the frontend team manage game download, installation and version control.

  • Designed and built backend system using NestJS, PostgreSQL, and AWS services (S3, SQS, Redis).

  • Created a CLI tool with Git-like file control for game developers to publish and manage game releases efficiently.

EV Charger Rentals (Mobile App, Full Stack):

  • Built cross-platform mobile applications using React Native, with Zustand, TanStack Query, and OpenAPI-generated clients.

  • Integrated Google Maps API for location-based features and Stripe for payments and deposit handling.

  • Delivered the MVP in one month, including OAuth authentication, core booking flows, and payment functionality.

  • Contributed across the full stack to turn product requirements into a working production-ready MVP.

Backend Development:

  • Developed high-performance backend services using Node.js (Fastify), which handles billions of IoT data points per month.

  • Designed and implemented caching strategies for heavy computations, including stateful and input-driven computations.

  • Built real-time features (e.g, live charts, notifications) using WebSocket.

  • Applied modulith architecture to balance modularity and maintainability within a single deployable system.

  • Wrote unit and integration tests to ensure reliability of critical features.

  • Implemented feature flag system to enable controlled rollouts, A/B testing, and safer deployments.

Designing database:

  • Designed and optimized query access patterns and indexing strategies to improve performance and scalability, particularly in Amazon DynamoDB.

  • Refactored MongoDB schema from normalized (3NF) to denormalized (2NF) to optimize read-heavy workloads, reducing join-like operations and improving query latency.

DevOps related work:

  • Built CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for automated testing, packaging, and deployment workflows.

  • Implemented observability stack using AWS X-Ray and Amazon CloudWatch for tracing, logging, and system monitoring.

  • Analyzed metrics and logs to identify bottlenecks and proactively propose system improvements.

  • Authored technical RFCs to propose new features and architectural improvements, contributing to long-term system evolution.

• Developed an internal social platform serving company employees.

  • Built GraphQL APIs with Node.js (NestJS), enabling flexible data querying and efficient frontend integration

  • Designed database schemas

  • Implemented CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI

  • Operated across backend and DevOps domains, bridging development and infrastructure to streamline delivery workflows

items.school: Ho Chi Minh University of Technology
